brief_rationale: The trajectory satisfies all responsibility-chain items with no in-chain errors. All red-flag symptoms were checked, medication safety was reinforced, follow-up plan was specific and executable, and family provided clear teach-back. Multiple high-order points were completed: communication adapted to respect patient autonomy (HO1), real-world barriers navigated with alternative options (HO2), hidden risks of asymptomatic denial discovered (HO3), and safe bounded closure achieved (HO4). At least two high-order points completed with meaningful trajectory impact, warranting grade 5.

citations.explanation: Doctor confirms understanding of monitoring thresholds, fluid intake, urine collection, and contingency plan
citations.quote: 喝水正常喝，不要故意多喝水“冲尿”

citations.explanation: Family provides complete teach-back demonstrating receipt of all key safety and follow-up instructions
citations.quote: 这两天我们就不自己停药、不减药，水正常喝

closure_assessment.explanation: Closure achieved with specific follow-up appointment (nephrology clinic in 2 days), responsible owner identified, red-flag contingencies defined, and family teach-back confirming comprehension. Allowed residual risks (exact follow-up date initially uncertain, prednisone course end unclear) were appropriately carried forward.

high_order_assessment.explanation: HO1 completed: Doctor respected patient autonomy by directing communication to include the patient ('she also heard this'), adapted messaging to reduce resistance ('not going to ER doesn't mean no follow-up'), and supported caregiver role without bypassing patient's participation.

citations.explanation: Doctor provides executable alternatives when facing real-world access barriers

high_order_assessment.explanation: HO2 completed: Doctor navigated scheduling/transport barriers by providing multiple executable pathways (original nephrology, alternative hospital nephrology, or general internal medicine), reducing family conflict about 'must go today' vs. 'can wait'.

citations.explanation: Doctor addresses hidden risk of patient downplaying follow-up due to normal blood pressure
citations.quote: 她现在说“不高就别去大医院”可以理解，但您得帮她守住一条线

high_order_assessment.explanation: HO3 completed: Doctor discovered the non-volunteered risk that asymptomatic patient would resist follow-up, and actively addressed it by explaining that lupus nephritis activity may not manifest in visible symptoms like blood pressure, requiring urine protein monitoring.

citations.explanation: Doctor explicitly defines bounded closure scope and carries forward residual uncertainties safely
citations.quote: 这两天关键就是：药一个不换、一个不停，正常生活，监测不放，异常就提前行动

high_order_assessment.explanation: HO4 completed: Doctor clearly delineated what this episode can and cannot resolve (can explain results and arrange next steps, cannot online determine remission or change medications), and carried forward allowed residual risks (exact medication schedule to be confirmed at clinic).

important_non_chain_defect_assessment.explanation: No important non-chain quality defects identified. All dimensions achieved good or excellent ratings, closure was safe/executable/traceable, and multiple high-order points were completed.
